title_en:
good morning creators

the final chapter is here 

@termix_ai has entered its final epoch (Epoch 4) on @KaitoAI 

this is the last opportunity to contribute, share genuine thoughts, and show support for the vision

campaign running from Nov 23 to Dec 22, 
the final epoch brings a reward pool of 32 bps, plus a separate 8 bps allocation for kaito stakers 

let's talk about what idea behind works https://t.co/NB92wv1xDD by @termix_ai 

imagine hiring an AI agent the same way you hire a person for a specific task

you explain what you need, agents compete for the job, the right one get selected and payment happens after the work is done

it's a combination of agent discovery, real work, verification, and onchain payments

It's not just about making AI smarter, it's about giving AI a place to work and create value

good morning creators

the final chapter is here 

@termix_ai has entered its final epoch (Epoch 4) on @KaitoAI 

this is the last opportunity to contribute, share genuine thoughts, and show support for the vision

campaign running from Nov 23 to Dec 22, 
the final epoch brings a reward pool of 32 bps, plus a separate 8 bps allocation for kaito stakers 

let's talk about what idea behind works https://t.co/NB92wv1xDD by @termix_ai 

imagine hiring an AI agent the same way you hire a person for a specific task

you explain what you need, agents compete for the job, the right one get selected and payment happens after the work is done

it's a combination of agent discovery, real work, verification, and onchain payments

It's not just about making AI smarter, it's about giving AI a place to work and create value

title: Yes, it is reasonable to expect AI models struggle more with unverifiable domains, but I do think it is worth noting that we also see very large gains in domains without automatic verification as well. Here are human evaluations of AI in writing, business problems
title_en: Yes, it is reasonable to expect AI models struggle more with unverifiable domains, but I do think it is worth noting that we also see very large gains in domains without automatic verification as well. Here are human evaluations of AI in writing, business problems
title_zh: 是的，我们有理由期望人工智能模型在无法验证的领域中遇到更多困难，但我确实认为值得注意的是，我们在没有自动验证的领域也看到了巨大的进步。以下是人类对人工智能的书面评估、商业问题

That's where @FensoryApp ta
title_en:
Giving an AI agent access to trading is one thing.

Giving it unlimited control is another.

That's where @FensoryApp takes an interesting approach.

Instead of relying only on instructions written in a prompt, Fensory lets users define trading permissions at the account level.

You can decide:

→ Which markets the agent is allowed to access
→ The maximum size of a single order
→ How long trading access remains active
→ When to disable agentic trading with a kill switch

Why does this matter?

Because an AI agent can misunderstand instructions, but account-level limits create boundaries that the prompt itself cannot override.

I think this is an important part of making agent-driven trading more controlled and transparent.

Of course, these controls don't eliminate market risk. Trading can still result in losses.

Explore the infrastructure: https://t.co/PDOQfFRYQa

Because an AI agent can misunderstand instructions, but account-level limits create boundaries that the prompt itself cannot override.

@FensoryApp
full_text_zh:
为人工智能代理提供交易权限是一回事。

给予它无限的控制权是另一回事。

这就是 @FensoryApp 采取有趣方法的地方。

Fensory 不只依赖于提示中编写的指令，而是让用户在账户级别定义交易权限。

您可以决定：

→ 代理商可以进入哪些市场
→ 单笔订单最大尺寸
→ 交易访问保持活跃状态多长时间
→ 何时使用终止开关禁用代理交易

为什么这很重要？

因为 AI 代理可能会误解指令，但帐户级别限制会创建提示本身无法覆盖的边界。

我认为这是使代理驱动的交易更加可控和透明的重要组成部分。

当然，这些控制并不能消除市场风险。交易仍然可能导致损失。

title_en:
Good Morning CT

Having a big wallet doesn't automatically make you trustworthy. That's where @zerufinance takes a different approach.

Its zScore looks at actual onchain behaviour across trading, staking, LP activity and governance, turning that history into a reputation score.

What makes this interesting is how Zeru connects reputation to real opportunities through Zaps, Activity Markets and institutional tools.

Your onchain history could become more than a transaction record. It could become your financial identity.
--------------------------------------------
An NFT that actually does something with your DeFi activity? That's an interesting shift.

@meetmotes connects each Genesis NFT to an AI Agent and dedicated Smart Account on Robinhood Chain.

You fund it with USDC, set your rules, and the Agent can explore opportunities across supported DeFi applications. Its Aave integration also brings lending, borrowing and collateral management into the picture.

The part I like most is that automation doesn't mean giving up control. You set the boundaries, and the Agent works within them.

One NFT, one Agent, one dedicated account. Much more than digital art.

summary_en: Apple Inc. is accelerating the development of an autonomous AI agent capable of automating web browsing, app interaction, coding, and device navigation. ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 苹果公司正加速开发具备自主能力的AI智能体，旨在实现对网络浏览、应用程序操控、代码编写及设备导航的全面自动化执行。根据内部招聘信息，该系统定位为 proactive agentic AI assistant，旨在模拟人类操作逻辑，预计最早于2026年底推出，以应对OpenAI、Anthropic及Meta在智能体领域的先发竞争。

elements_en.why: To bridge gaps in the AI agent ecosystem and compete with Meta, OpenAI, and Anthropic

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 苹果的介入标志着AI智能体赛道从单纯的模型能力竞争转向OS级的系统整合竞争。通过将智能体深度嵌入底层架构，苹果意图构建极高的平台壁垒，此举将迫使竞品加速从云端应用向终端侧的深度融合，并可能重塑现有的AI应用分发格局。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Apple's entry signifies a pivot in the AI agent race from pure model capability to OS-level system integration. By embedding agents deep into its underlying architecture, Apple aims to establish a high platform barrier, forcing competitors to accelerate integration from cloud-based applications to the edge, potentially reshaping the current AI application distribution landscape.

title_en:
I just installed a $20,000 AI Business Brain for a 7-figure founder that does the work of 3 full-time hires.

(30 days later, he closed 1 deal that netted his company $41,500)

Most business owners buy 5 seats of ChatGPT, hand them to their team, and wonder why every draft still reads like a generic high school essay.

A blank chat tab has zero context on how your company actually makes money.

→ No more $75,000/year operations hires who take 4 months to learn your pricing rules
→ No more $5,000/month lead-gen agencies sending generic templates that get 1% replies
→ No more 2+ hours digging through county deeds, skip-tracing tools, and spreadsheets by hand
→ No more re-explaining your margins, past deals, and SOPs in every new chat window

Just 1 local company system on your laptop → research, outbound, and proposals running in your exact judgment.

Here's how the system works:

→ Company Memory Layer (wires your clients, pricing floors, past won scopes, and SOPs into one persistent local workspace)
→ Autonomous Research Engine (turns 2 hours of deed, obituary, and relative digging into an 8-minute verified brief)
→ Outbound & Lead Triage Pipeline (opens 100+ targeted seller conversations/day and scores replies against your real margin rules)
→ Same-Hour Proposal Architect (pulls live call transcripts and drafts ready-to-sign scopes before the buyer leaves his desk)
→ Bidirectional Learning Loop (every correction and decision you make updates the system permanently so you never repeat yourself twice)

Built around the real revenue jobs inside your company.

Installed in 3 afternoons. Runs on your own computer with zero recurring agency payroll.

Results from live client installs:
- $41,500 net profit closed on Deal #1 within 30 days of install (California claims firm)
- 12 full-time sales reps ($500,000/year payroll) replaced by 1 laptop running on $400/month in AI compute
- $52,000 in new agency retainers closed in 11 days from same-day interactive proposals

I recorded a complete 22-minute screen walkthrough showing the exact folder architecture, the Claude Code setup, and the live client workflows from start to finish.

title_en: 😳 Ant Ling open-sourced 2x medical AI models in 1x day. 😷 One is a 124B model that can see 👀 and interpret medical images. The other is a massive 560B medical reasoning model with 25B active parameters. ... and Ant claims the 560B model beats GPT-6
title_zh: 蚂蚁集团开源两款医疗AI模型
author: @TeksEdge
summary_en: Ant Ling has open-sourced two medical AI models: a 124B vision model for medical image interpretation and a 560B medical reasoning model with 25B active parameters. The organization claims that the 560B model outperforms GPT-6 in clinical reasoning benchmarks.
summary_zh: 蚂蚁集团开源124B视觉医疗模型及560B医疗推理模型，后者声称在性能上超越GPT-6。
full_text_zh: 😳 Ant Ling 在 1x 天内开源了 2x 个医疗 AI 模型。 😷 一种是 124B 模型，可以看到 👀 并解释医学图像。另一个是具有25B个主动参数的海量560B医学推理模型。 ...Ant 声称 560B 模型击败了 GPT-6

quote_en: 😳 Ant Ling open-sourced 2x medical AI models in 1x day. 😷 One is a 124B model that can see 👀 and interpret medical images. The other is a massive 560B medical reasoning model with 25B active parameter

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 蚂蚁集团（Ant Ling）发布并开源两款医疗专用AI模型：一款为具备医疗影像分析能力的124B参数模型，另一款为拥有560B参数规模、具备25B活跃参数的医疗推理模型。该机构宣称其560B模型在临床推理表现上已超越GPT-6基准。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Ant Ling has open-sourced two medical AI models: a 124B vision model for medical image interpretation and a 560B medical reasoning model with 25B active parameters. The organization claims that the 560B model outperforms GPT-6 in clinical reasoning benchmarks.

elements_zh.where: AI开源社区
elements_zh.what: 开源124B视觉医疗模型及560B医疗推理模型
elements_zh.why: 推动医疗AI专用领域的性能极限与技术民主化

elements_en.what: Open-sourced a 124B vision model and a 560B medical reasoning model
elements_en.why: To push the performance frontier in specialized medical AI and foster open innovation

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 医疗AI正从通用多模态向专业领域深耕，蚂蚁集团通过超大规模参数与稀疏激活（25B活跃）架构，旨在解决复杂临床逻辑处理中的长尾效应。此举将医疗大模型从“闭源黑盒”推向开源，将迫使商业化医疗AI厂商重新评估其高昂的预训练成本与闭源壁垒。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Medical AI is shifting from general-purpose multimodality to domain-specific expertise, leveraging massive parameter counts with sparse activation to handle clinical logic complexity. By open-sourcing these frontier models, Ant Ling challenges the proprietary moat of commercial medical AI providers and forces a reassessment of cost-to-performance ratios in healthcare AI.

填补专业医疗领域推理模型公开化空白，强化视觉与临床逻辑整合能力
key_points_en: Ant Ling open-sourced 124B and 560B medical AI models
560B model uses sparse activation (25B active params) and claims to outperform GPT-6
Fills the gap in open-source clinical reasoning models and integrates medical vision with logic

@krutosh @huxlab I wasn't involved in the technical side of Llama.
I was merely involved in arguing for opening Llama-2.
The opening of Llama-2 jump-started the AI industry.
Llama-3 was good.
Llama-4 was a disappointment because the team was under huge time pressure and had to be conservative.
Then Mark rebooted the whole AI organization and the open model policy was temporarily put on hold.
After that (but not entirely because of that), I left to start AMI Labs.

title:
T3 Code founder just shared his personal setup for building agentic teams with Grok Bot + Opus 5.5

one Grok Bot runs yo
title_en:
T3 Code founder just shared his personal setup for building agentic teams with Grok Bot + Opus 5.5

one Grok Bot runs your whole fleet of machines. Opus 5.5 does the coding. you only approve

how:

→ Grok Bot gets one MCP link to T3 Code
→ you give it one rule: code goes to Opus 5.5
→ it spins up threads on every machine you own
→ works from your phone, even with the laptop closed

save the video, here's the guide:

• step 0 → what it is:

Grok Bot = always-on agent with its own cloud computer

T3 Code = open-source control plane for coding agents. free, runs on your machines, uses your subscriptions

• step 1 → the stack:

- Claude $100 plan → Opus 5.5 for the actual code
- Grok Bot → the dispatcher that never sleeps
- T3 Code on every box you want it to control

• step 2 → connect the fleet:

run npx t3 connect on each machine. one command, free, no Tailscale needed

• step 3 → give Grok Bot the keys:

Settings → Environments → Copy MCP URL → paste it into Grok Bot, sign in with OAuth. it can now see every linked machine

• step 4 → the one rule Theo uses:

tell Grok Bot "call T3 Code with Opus 5.5 for any task where it is applicable"

code runs on your Claude plan, Grok Bot's limits stay free for planning

• step 5 → make it work:

- "spin up an Opus 5.5 thread on each machine to check disk & RAM"
- "go through these PRs and pick the best ones"
- "split the backlog, one thread per issue, each in its own worktree"

every thread gets its own branch. nothing merges without your approval

what to expect:
- 8 threads on 8 machines from one chat (Theo's demo)
- works over the internet, not computer use
- control everything from your phone
- T3 Code: $0. you pay for Claude + Grok Bot only

honest take:

this is a dispatcher, not magic. bad briefs still give bad PRs, and you still review every diff. the win: your agents keep working while you're away from the desk

Save it so you don't lose it. 

then read the full guide on building AI agent teams in T3 Code in the article below ↓

full_text_zh:
T3 Code 创始人刚刚分享了他使用 Grok Bot + Opus 5.5 构建代理团队的个人设置

一个 Grok Bot 可以运行您的整个机器群。 Opus 5.5 负责编码。你只认可

如何：

→ Grok Bot 获得一个指向 T3 代码的 MCP 链接
→ 你给它一条规则：代码转到 Opus 5.5
→ 它会在你拥有的每台机器上旋转线程
→ 即使笔记本电脑关闭，也可以通过手机工作

保存视频，这是指南：

• 步骤 0 → 它是什么：

Grok Bot = 拥有自己的云计算机的永远在线代理

T3 Code = 用于编码代理的开源控制平面。免费，在您的计算机上运行，​​使用您的订阅

• 步骤1 → 堆栈：

- Claude 100 美元计划 → Opus 5.5 的实际代码
- Grok Bot → 不眠的调度员
- 您希望它控制的每个盒子上都有 T3 代码

• 步骤2 → 连接车队：

在每台计算机上运行 npx t3 connect。一个命令，免费，无需 Tailscale

• 步骤 3 → 给 Grok Bot 密钥：

设置 → 环境 → 复制 MCP URL → 将其粘贴到 Grok Bot，使用 OAuth 登录。它现在可以看到每台链接的机器

• 步骤 4 → Theo 使用的一条规则：

告诉 Grok Bot“使用 Opus 5.5 调用 T3 代码来执行任何适用的任务”

代码在您的 Claude 计划上运行，Grok Bot 的限制对计划保持免费

• 步骤 5 → 使其发挥作用：

- “在每台机器上启动 Opus 5.5 线程来检查磁盘和 RAM”
-“浏览这些 PR 并选择最好的”
- “拆分待办事项，每个问题一个线程，每个线程都在自己的工作树中”

每个线程都有自己的分支。未经您的批准，任何内容都不会合并

期待什么：
- 8 台机器上的 8 个线程通过一次聊天（Theo 的演示）
- 通过互联网工作，而不是使用计算机
- 通过手机控制一切
- T3 代码：0 美元。您只需支付 Claude + Grok Bot 的费用

诚实地采取：

这是调度员，不是魔法。糟糕的内裤仍然会带来糟糕的公关，而你仍然会审查每一个差异。胜利：当您离开办公桌时，您的座席仍能继续工作

保存它，以免丢失。

然后阅读下面文章中关于在 T3 代码中构建 AI 代理团队的完整指南 ↓

title:
@elonmusk @Liv_Boeree TIL: We have superintelligence  but we still don't have level-5 autonomous driving. 

A task that
title_en:
@elonmusk @Liv_Boeree TIL: We have superintelligence  but we still don't have level-5 autonomous driving. 

A task that most 17 year olds can learn in 20 hours of practice. 
And we have (you have) billions of hours of training data.
 
We don't have robots that can come close to doing what an 8 year old can do with no prior training.

And let's not talk about cats.

That's a rather strange kind of superintelligence.
title_zh:
@elonmusk @Liv_Boeree TIL：我们拥有超级智能，但我们仍然没有 5 级自动驾驶。

大多数 17 岁的孩子可以通过 20 小时的练习来完成这项任务。
我们拥有（你拥有）数十亿小时的训练数据。

我们没有任何机器人

title: FYI: I recently discovered that Claude Code can do incredible genealogical research on your family tree for free. Not su

title: @merettm Pretraining should just be called “training”. You can’t have pre and post, but never have actual training. Like
title_en:
@merettm Pretraining should just be called “training”. You can’t have pre and post, but never have actual training. Like, you dress up to work out and then you shower, but don’t actually work out 😂

Unless I’m super missing something, data starvation will be the training challenge next year.
title_zh:
@merettm 预训练应该被称为“训练”。你不可能有事前和事后，但永远不会有实际的训练。就像，你穿好衣服去锻炼，然后洗澡，但实际上并没有锻炼😂

除非我超级错过了什么，否则数据匮乏将成为明年的训练挑战。

🎭U may feel sucker-punched by a deflated portfolio🤮💥🥊 or elated by your stink bid orders finally getting filled🦨🛒😊 but the fact remains that even tho many #Uranium #mining #stocks now sit at unwarranted 52-week lows from being coupled to flushed #AI & #Metals sectors🧺🤖💻🪙⤵️🚽 the Uranium investing thesis is far more bullish today than it was in February when U equities were trading at 52-week highs!⬆️⚛️⛏️🐂 The #Nuclear fuel demand tailwinds are blowing far harder now than they were 9 months ago🌀⚛️🏗️👷 and the Long-term  price has kept on rising since January to a new all-time high of $99📈💲🌋 as Spot has bounced back to $90.⤴️🛢️☢️

💲⏫ Nuclear fuel consultants TradeTech reported on 31 October that the Long-term U3O8 price, THE key parameter used by analysts to calculate the economic value of a company's Uranium resources & mine projects, has steadily risen since January by over 11% from $89 to a new all-time industry high of $99!🌟

⛽️ Reactor fuel demand has seen a significant increase since January. The World Nuclear Association reports that:

⬆️⚛️⚡️ 8 new reactors have come online (+8.5GW) bringing the global total to 444 (407GW).  NO reactors have been permanently shut down this year!

⬆️⚛️🏗️ 10 more reactors have launched construction. (+8GW)  There are now 81 reactors under construction worldwide (90GW), the highest since 1986, 40 years ago!

⬆️⚛️👷 15 previously proposed reactors have entered the pipeline of planned reactors awaiting construction, for a total of 119 (108 GW).

⏫⚛️🌍 18 more reactors have been added to the list of new units being proposed worldwide, now at 336 (299 GW).😲

👥♨️ At this year's COP31 Climate Change conference it was announced that another 17 nations have added their signatures to the COP28 declaration to TRIPLE global Nuclear power capacity from today's 407 Gigawatts to at least 1,200 Gigawatts by 2050. That's a +77% increase from 22 to 39 countries, which now includes 8 of the world's 10 largest economies!

⏫🇺🇸 The United States under the Democrats' Biden administration co-led the COP28 TRIPLE Nuclear pledge, but in May 2025 the Trump administration upped it to a QUADRUPLE of US Nuclear power generation from 100GW to 400GW by 2050.  A massive increase in US Nuclear power generation is a goal supported by both Democrats & Republicans in Congress! 🫏🐘🏛️🧑‍⚖️✅

⛏️ On the Uranium supply side a tale of production woes has been unfolding this year.😢  As per Mike Alkin's chart of missed production targets below, new supply has been seriously constrained by technical mining issues & setbacks, rising production & financing costs, etc., with the small number of new mine construction projects facing similar hurdles in bringing needed supply online in the coming years.🐌  Mining is hard, and uranium mining is the hardest!⚛️⛏️😩

🏦 A consensus of global investment banks is now projecting a structural supply deficit in each of the next 10 years, growing to over 45M lbs in 2035 with no visible path to bringing on enough new supply to meet soaring demand into the 2040s.  ⚖️🚫

📶 Supply vs demand datapoints underscore a Uranium sector that is far more bullish today than it was back in January, with the longer-term outlook pushing the bullish indicators to extreme!⚛️⛏️🔥🌡️🐂🔮👀  The bullish Nuclear news flow since January has increased from a rushing river♒️ to an unprecedented mind-blowing torrent📰⚛️🌊🤯 as a global Nuclear Renaissance has continued to accelerate🏎️🔥 picking up additional tailwinds from the world's largest tech giants committing to secure massive amounts of clean, 24/7 reliable, carbon-free Nuclear energy to power their data center expansion plans.⚛️⚡️🔌🤖💻

And there's the rub...🐈‍⬛ Uranium company executives and Wall Street analysts heavily promoted Uranium as the "picks and shovels" play on AI!🤑  Portfolio Managers, hedge funds and investment bankers loaded up their AI thematic baskets with stocks & ETFs from the tiny illiquid Uranium space.🧺💻🤖⚛️⛏️🛒🐒 

🎈As a result, the deflation of the so-called AI trade for the past many months has led to the dumping of a large volume of Uranium stocks & ETFs into the market, hammering down the U sector.📉💥🔨

🤕To add insult to injury, falling gold & silver prices have led to even more dumping of uranium stocks into the market, as traders & fund managers also hold U stocks & ETFs in the same Metals & Mining baskets as their gold & silver stocks, amplifying the downward pressure on Uranium stocks as they go risk-off and empty their Metals & Mining baskets too!🧺🪙⚛️⛏️⤵️🗑️

Short sellers joined in to try to put the final nail in the Uranium sector coffin.⚰️🔨🩳🤑

🚨🆘🚑 So, here we are today with the tiny Uranium sector beaten down to extremely oversold levels in complete opposition to the sector's far more bullish demand vs supply fundamentals.🔀↕️🤪

The silver lining for U?🌤️  The gap between market pricing💩 and true intrinsic asset values💎 has now widened to a completely irrational extreme↕️🤪 with charts giving off screaming BUY signals to those Portfolio Managers, hedge funds and investment bankers sitting with large wads of cash and nearly empty AI and Metals & Mining baskets to refill.🧺⛽️💰

🧾✍️ Q4 also usually sees the strongest volume of the year when it comes to new Long-term supply contracts being signed by utilities, along with typically strong upward price momentum in the Spot market heading into January.  That's why Uranium stocks & ETFs are normally in a strong seasonal rally at this time of year.📈🎅

🌊As has happened for this tiny sector before, we could see the start of a new wave of high volume buying by traders, funds, institutions and retail as they finally come to realize the incredible investing opportunity now being offered.🗜️💥💣  The potential for a rapid recovery rally back to 52-week highs has never been greater!⤴️🌟 Uranium stocks could even decouple from the broader markets and strike out on their own given the extreme asymmetric upside potential now on offer.🎁📈⚛️⛏️💰 Especially if the Long-term U3O8 price hits $100 or higher when reported at the end of November. 💯🌋

🤠As always, how and when U choose to participate in an inevitable U sector recovery rally is totally up to U!🤔  It's your money so invest it wisely🦉 according to your own unique financial goals, research, experience & skills, risk appetite, time horizon and conviction.🎭 Get ready to ride the coming wave!🌊🏄 Good luck with your trades!☘️🌈💰

🎭你可能会因投资组合萎缩🤮💥🥊而感到受挫，或者因臭味投标订单终于被填满而感到高兴🦨🛒😊但事实仍然是，即使有很多#Uranium #mining #stocks现在也因与#AI和#Metals的结合而处于毫无根据的52周低点部门🧺🤖💻🪙⤵️🚽今天的铀投资理论比2月份更加乐观，当时U股交易处于52周高位！⬆️⚛️⛏️🐂#核燃料需求的顺风现在比9个月前吹得更猛烈🌀⚛️🏗️👷和长期价格自 1 月份以来持续上涨，并创下历史新高 99 美元📈💲🌋，现货价格已反弹至 90 美元。⤴️🛢️☢️

💲⏫ 核燃料顾问 TradeTech 于 10 月 31 日报告称，长期 U3O8 价格（分析师用来计算公司铀资源和矿山项目经济价值的关键参数）自 1 月份以来已稳步上涨超过 11%，从 89 美元升至 99 美元的历史新行业高点！🌟

⛽️ 自一月份以来，反应堆燃料需求显着增加。世界核协会报告称：

⬆️⚛️⚡️ 8 个新反应堆已上线（+8.5GW），使全球总数达到 444 个（407GW）。 今年没有任何反应堆被永久关闭！

⬆️⚛️🏗️另有10座反应堆已启动建设。 (+8GW) 全球目前有 81 座反应堆在建 (90GW)，是 40 年前 1986 年以来的最高水平！

⬆️⚛️👷 15 个先前提议的反应堆已进入待建计划反应堆的管道，总数为 119 个（108 吉瓦）。

⏫⚛️🌍 全球拟议的新机组清单中又添加了 18 个反应堆，目前已达到 336 个（299 吉瓦）。😲

👥♨️ 在今年的 COP31 气候变化会议上，宣布又有 17 个国家在 COP28 宣言中签字，到 2050 年，全球核电容量将增加三倍，从目前的 407 吉瓦增加到至少 1,200 吉瓦。这一数字从 22 个国家增加到 39 个国家，增加了 77%，其中包括世界 10 个最大经济体中的 8 个国家！

⏫🇺🇸民主党拜登政府领导下的美国共同主导了COP28三重核承诺，但2025年5月，特朗普政府将其提升至2050年美国核电发电量的四倍，从100GW增加到400GW。大幅增加美国核电发电量是国会民主党和共和党都支持的目标！ 🫏🐘🏛️🧑‍⚖️✅

⛏️ 在铀供应方面，今年的生产困境已经上演。😢 根据迈克·阿尔金（Mike Alkin）下面的未完成生产目标图表，新供应受到采矿技术问题和挫折、生产和融资成本上升等严重制约，少数新矿建设项目在未来几年上线所需供应方面面临类似的障碍。🐌 采矿是艰难的，而铀矿开采是最重要的最难！⚛️⛏️😩

🏦 全球投资银行目前达成的共识是，预计未来 10 年每年都会出现结构性供应赤字，到 2035 年将增长到超过 4500 万磅，而且没有明显的途径来提供足够的新供应来满足 2040 年代飙升的需求。 ⚖️🚫

📶 供需数据点突显了铀行业今天比 1 月份更加看涨，长期前景将看涨指标推向极端！⚛️⛏️🔥🌡️🐂🔮👀 自 1 月份以来看涨的核新闻流已经从汹涌的河流♒️增加到前所未有的令人兴奋的程度torrent📰⚛️🌊🤯 全球核复兴持续加速🏎️🔥 从世界上最大的科技巨头那里获得额外的推动力，这些巨头致力于获得大量清洁、24/7 可靠、无碳的核能，为其数据中心扩建计划提供动力。⚛️⚡️🔌🤖💻

还有一个问题...🐈‍⬛ 铀公司高管和华尔街分析师大力宣传铀，因为它是人工智能中的“镐和铲子”！🤑 投资组合经理、对冲基金和投资银行家在他们的人工智能主题篮子里装满了来自微小的非流动性铀空间的股票和 ETF。🧺💻🤖⚛️⛏️🛒🐒

🎈结果，过去几个月所谓的AI贸易通货紧缩导致大量铀股和ETF抛售市场，重创美国板块。📉💥🔨

🤕雪上加霜的是，黄金和白银价格下跌导致更多的铀股倾销到市场，因为交易员和基金经理也将U股和ETF与黄金和白银股票放在同一金属和矿业篮子中，从而放大了铀股的下行压力，因为他们规避风险并清空了金属和矿业篮子！🧺🪙⚛️⛏️⤵️🗑️

卖空者加入进来，试图给铀业的棺材钉上最后一颗钉子。⚰️🔨🩳🤑

🚨🆘🚑 所以，今天我们看到小小的铀行业被打到极度超卖的水平，完全违背了该行业远为看涨的需求与供应基本面。🔀↕️🤪

美国的一线希望？🌤️市场定价💩和真正的内在资产价值💎之间的差距现在已经扩大到完全非理性的极端↕️🤪，图表向那些持有大量现金和几乎空空的人工智能和金属和矿业篮子的投资组合经理、对冲基金和投资银行家发出尖叫的买入信号。🧺⛽️💰

🧾✍️ 当公用事业公司签署新的长期供应合同时，第四季度通常也会出现一年中最强劲的成交量，并且进入一月份现货市场的价格上涨势头通常强劲。 这就是为什么铀股票和 ETF 通常在每年的这个时候出现强劲的季节性反弹。📈🎅

🌊正如这个小行业之前发生的那样，我们可以看到交易员、基金、机构和散户开始新一波大批量买盘，因为他们终于意识到现在提供的令人难以置信的投资机会。🗜️💥💣快速复苏反弹至 52 周高点的潜力从未如此之大！⤴️🌟 鉴于极端不对称的上行潜力，铀股甚至可能与更广泛的市场脱钩并自行出击现已发售。🎁📈⚛️⛏️💰 特别是如果长期 U3O8 价格在 11 月底报告时达到 100 美元或更高。 💯🌋

🤠一如既往，你选择如何以及何时参与不可避免的U行业复苏反弹完全取决于你！🤔这是你的钱，所以根据你自己独特的财务目标、研究、经验和技能、风险偏好、时间范围和信念明智地投资🦉。🎭准备好驾驭即将到来的浪潮！🌊🏄祝你交易顺利！☘️🌈💰

title: I’ve been having “Fix It Days” with Opus 5.5 where I just lay out a list of things that aren’t working and go one by one
title_en:
I’ve been having “Fix It Days” with Opus 5.5 where I just lay out a list of things that aren’t working and go one by one and fix them. 

Oh, Paramount+ is blurry? Okay. 

Check another episode, check another show, check another app, reset the app, unplug the TV. Boom. Fixed. 

Your iCloud is messed up? 
Your thermostat keeps resetting?
Your clock won’t keep time?
Your closet door won’t close right? 
Bank keeps mailing your old address?

I could have figured these all out on my own or with YouTube, but it’s far less stressful and I get through them faster.
title_zh:
我一直在使用 Opus 5.5 进行“修复日”，我只是列出了一系列不起作用的事情，然后逐一修复它们。

哦，Paramount+ 模糊了？好的。

检查另一集，检查另一个节目，检查另一个应用程序，重置应用程序，拔掉电视插头。繁荣。固定的

author: @omarsar0
summary_en: Google's research team has introduced BuggyMLE, a machine learning engineering evaluation framework designed to address the saturation of current repository-level coding benchmarks. By intentionally injecting artificial bugs into tasks, the framework forces large models to demonstrate performance under more complex debugging and system-level engineering conditions, enabling finer-grained stress testing of model coding capabilities.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 谷歌研究团队发布名为BuggyMLE的机器学习工程评估框架，旨在应对当前仓库级编码基准测试趋于饱和的难题。该技术通过在测试任务中主动注入人工错误，迫使大模型在更复杂的纠错与系统级工程场景中展现性能，从而实现对模型编码能力的精细化压力测试。

elements_zh.where: 机器学习工程领域/学术发布
elements_zh.what: 推出BuggyMLE基准框架，利用主动注入代码缺陷提升智能体工程能力
elements_zh.why: 现有仓库级基准测试趋于饱和，无法有效衡量AI处理复杂真实工程问题的能力

elements_en.what: Launched BuggyMLE benchmark, using active bug injection to improve agent engineering skills
elements_en.why: Existing repository-level benchmarks are saturating and fail to measure real-world complex engineering tasks

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 通过BuggyMLE实现从‘生成代码’向‘工程化调试’的范式转变，揭示了LLM基准测试正从静态数据集匹配向动态对抗演进。这种基于错误反馈闭环的训练逻辑，是AI智能体实现工业级软件交付能力的必经路径，能够显著提升模型在处理分布式系统缺陷时的鲁棒性。
ai_analysis.insight_en: BuggyMLE signals a paradigm shift from simple code generation to systematic debugging, illustrating that LLM benchmarking is evolving from static dataset matching to dynamic adversarial evaluation. This feedback-loop approach is essential for AI agents to achieve industrial-grade delivery capabilities and significantly improves model robustness in handling distributed system defects.

What's difficult is to reproduce is the kind of real-world learning that takes place in a baby cat, octopus, or cuckoo bird that never meets its parents.

“Given that the main way new surprising capabilities emerge is by progress on compression, a measure rooted in perplexity could give us a shared benchmark for general intelligence, regardless of the degree of automation of the development process. Extrapolating from recent progress, we should expect further transformative capabilities as we enter the ~0.68-0.7 log-perplexity window.”

this chart is one of the most beautiful ways to tell the story of the last 4 years. it also shows that a lot of the post training issues we debate is kinda the B plot to the overall A plot of large scale pretrain progress.
full_text_zh:
OpenAI 提出将困惑度作为行业自我调节和节奏的通用指标（而不是 FLOPS）

“鉴于新的令人惊讶的能力出现的主要方式是压缩方面的进步，无论开发过程的自动化程度如何，植根于困惑度的衡量标准都可以为我们提供通用智能的共同基准。从最近的进展推断，当我们进入 ~0.68-0.7 log-perplexity 窗口时，我们应该期待进一步的变革能力。”

这张图表是讲述过去 4 年故事的最美丽的方式之一。它还表明，我们争论的许多训练后问题有点像大规模训练前进展的总体 A 图的 B 图。

author_role: AI Engineer Foundation / Latent Space 主理人

title: I helped start OpenAI because I want AGI to be safe and beneficial for people. This post provides transparency that can
title_en:
I helped start OpenAI because I want AGI to be safe and beneficial for people. This post provides transparency that can be the foundation of industry-wide shared safety bars.

Perhaps the most important concept from the post is the following: "AI will also significantly contribute to progress on alignment and monitoring, I think that progress is unlikely to be fast enough to allow the full potential acceleration in pretraining."

Towards ensuring that safety keeps pace with general intelligence of pretrained models (as measured by "perplexity"), the post proposes "common limits, based on perplexity and other measurements, that developers are committed to not crossing until our ability to understand and monitor AI behavior achieves a certain concrete milestone (such as the development of a successor to CoT monitors)."

The general idea is to create a first shared limit, on some shared key metric, along with concrete exit criteria that would allow going beyond that. This can lead to a "common framework for setting successive limits and pacing further development".

Excited to move forward the conversation on pacing towards shared standards that are rooted in the science!

full_text_en:
I helped start OpenAI because I want AGI to be safe and beneficial for people. This post provides transparency that can be the foundation of industry-wide shared safety bars.

Perhaps the most important concept from the post is the following: "AI will also significantly contribute to progress on alignment and monitoring, I think that progress is unlikely to be fast enough to allow the full potential acceleration in pretraining."

Towards ensuring that safety keeps pace with general intelligence of pretrained models (as measured by "perplexity"), the post proposes "common limits, based on perplexity and other measurements, that developers are committed to not crossing until our ability to understand and monitor AI behavior achieves a certain concrete milestone (such as the development of a successor to CoT monitors)."

The general idea is to create a first shared limit, on some shared key metric, along with concrete exit criteria that would allow going beyond that. This can lead to a "common framework for setting successive limits and pacing further development".

Excited to move forward the conversation on pacing towards shared standards that are rooted in the science!
full_text_zh:
我帮助创立了 OpenAI，因为我希望 AGI 对人们来说是安全且有益的。这篇文章提供了透明度，可以成为全行业共享安全栏的基础。

也许这篇文章中最重要的概念如下：“人工智能还将极大地促进对齐和监控方面的进展，我认为进展不太可能快到足以实现预训练的全部潜在加速。”

为了确保安全性与预训练模型的通用智能（以“困惑度”衡量）保持同步，该帖子提出了“基于困惑度和其他衡量标准的共同限制，开发人员承诺在我们理解和监控人工智能行为的能力达到某个具体里程碑（例如开发 CoT 监视器的继任者）之前不会跨越这些限制。”

总体思路是在某些共享关键指标上创建第一个共享限制，以及允许超越该限制的具体退出标准。这可以形成一个“设定连续限制和进一步发展步伐的共同框架”。

很高兴能够推进关于迈向植根于科学的共同标准的对话！
